svg.title: OSW fluid geography of Earth's ocean
svg.desc: An ocean-first conceptual map on Natural Earth coastlines. This water-first rendering masks land with the ocean palette and retains only ghost coastlines so fluid features lead the figure-ground hierarchy. Twelve numbered callouts identify continent-like warm reservoirs, boundary-current pathways, transient anomalies, buried polar water masses, the Antarctic Circumpolar Current, and exchange gates. Reservoirs use irregular fluid coastlines to distinguish persistent or seasonal heatmasses from round transient blobs. All heat shapes and pathways are schematic, permeable, and moving rather than measured boundaries. The figure does not calculate heat content or transport.
